answers.core:
i don't see why this can't be an add-on.

this would help in games with changing level geometry like the voxel game — but many games have fixed levels that don't have invisible 'inner tiles' in the first place, so they don't need this feature
answers.workaround:
i could setup 2 Gridmaps in the scene:
the 'full' version and the 'visible' version.

on ready, i use the interior culling algorithm to create the 'visible' version from the 'full' version.

every time a tile changes, i first change it in the 'full' version before updating the 3×3 surrounding area in the 'visible' version.

this workaround would be very complex and i would have to change the inner workings of the game completely, but i feel like it Can be done
